description: Configure a GPIO pin on `agent` by number. type: input/output/vcc/gnd/remove. init: 0/1/last. pullup: up/down/none (input only). max: max pulse duration in seconds (output only). reversed: active-low logic (input/output only). watched: trigger webhook on state change (logged on the agent if no notifications.webhook is configured). script: a script from the agent's scripts folder to run when the pin's value changes (input/output only), "[on:|off:]<file> [args]": "on:" runs it only when the pin goes to 1, "off:" only when it goes to 0 (no value is passed), and with no prefix it runs on both and gets 1 or 0 as its last argument; an empty string clears it. Needs agent 0.9.50 or later.
name: mcp_gpio_config
title: Configure a pin
